title: No module named Bio
story: `gc_content.py` uses Biopython. The system's `python3` doesn't have it, but the anaconda module's Python does. Run the script on genes.fasta and report the GC content of {{gene}}.

files.~/{{project}}/gc_content.py:
"""GC content of every sequence in a FASTA file, with Biopython."""
import sys
from Bio import SeqIO
from Bio.SeqUtils import gc_fraction

for record in SeqIO.parse(sys.argv[1], "fasta"):
    print(f"{record.id}\t{len(record.seq)} bp\tGC {gc_fraction(record.seq) * 100:.1f}%")
